rationale: EO 12437 (August 11, 1983, 48 FR 36801) is one paragraph, read in full from the held Federal Register page, whose only command is that Executive Order No. 12217 is revoked. A revocation order is performed when issued, so its own command was spent on August 11, 1983 and the order has no continuing predicate on 2026-10-14. The two history observations (the Federal Register disposition note recording that it revokes EO 12217 of June 18, 1980, and the 1989 codification row recording that it revokes EO 12217) only recite what this order did to EO 12217; neither shows a later action on EO 12437. The held U.S. Code note under 42 U.S.C. 8373 likewise recites that EO 12217 was revoked by this order. The order's number is cited in no other held order text. Recommended: no.
